title: Controlled CIR/EIR normalization and GDR/OAI inventory migration
invariants: Preserve original files and Git history; no destructive rewrite or history alteration.
Never treat OAI metadata as governance approval.
Do not select a winner for conflicting source claims without an authorized decision.
Do not infer that missing evidence proves an event did not occur.
Preserve source version, correction, split, supersession, and review lineage.
Keep GOV-DEC-C1 unresolved until an authorized governance decision is recorded.
Do not count batch containers as individual source/evidence instances.

changes_proposed: Replace references to SRC-CORPUS-001-ENTRIES.md and SRC-CORPUS-001-ENTRIES-2.md with references to the existing source-batch registration files only after each referenced source ID is confirmed against the batch contents.
Separate source registration locations from supporting full-text/search reports.
Reconcile claimed total of 16 against the 14 table rows and later SRC-000017/018/019 records.
acceptance: Every source ID has a reviewed record location or an explicit unresolved/missing-evidence status.
Counts are computed from unique source IDs, not batch file count.
No source is marked registered solely because a heading exists in a mixed-purpose report.

changes_proposed: Use repository-relative paths for source/evidence detail locations.
Represent EV-000003 version 1.1 and its temporal-scope split as explicit lineage without erasing the prior version.
Represent EV-000005 supersession by EV-000009 alongside any correction revision.
Determine whether EV-000012 meets the evidence record contract before adding it.
acceptance: Every listed evidence ID has a validated record location or documented exception.
Correction and supersession links are consistent and acyclic.
Status conflicts remain visible until adjudicated.

changes_proposed: Retain existing staged OAI records as historical claims with provenance.
Add only reviewed individual artifacts to the migration map and staged package in a later PR.
Keep batch containers distinct from instance records.
acceptance: Migration map and staged files have one-to-one ID parity.
All source paths exist and each record passes OAI schema validation.
No proposal is silently promoted to canonical/staged.

changes_proposed: No status change; recover qualifying review evidence or obtain explicit authorized decision.
acceptance: C1 remains unresolved unless a separately recorded authorized decision supersedes this status.

changes_proposed: Propose language explaining GDR governance authority, OAI inventory role, and the fact that current migration package is staged rather than applied.
Preserve historical claims in provenance rather than deleting them.
acceptance: No entrypoint claims migration is complete before the canonical migration PR is merged.

required_gates.name: Content review
required_gates.required_evidence: Per-ID CIR/EIR review with exact path, current state, and source provenance.

required_gates.name: Governance review
required_gates.required_evidence: Authorized approval of registry authority and handling of conflicting status claims.

required_gates.name: Automated validation
required_gates.required_evidence: Schema, path existence, unique IDs, map/staged parity, lineage consistency, and unit tests passing.

required_gates.name: Separate migration PR
required_gates.required_evidence: Reviewable diff that changes canonical files only after G1-G3, with rollback and provenance notes.

rollback: Because this phase applies no canonical edits, rollback is simply to close/revise the plan PR. Any later canonical migration must be a separate reviewable commit and preserve pre-migration content in Git history.
next_action: Phase 30 should build a per-ID review matrix for CIR/EIR and only then prepare a separately gated canonical migration PR.
